# Marketing Content Strategy
Create content strategies grounded in Odoo CRM/sales data.
## Process 1. Read customer context (marketing.context: ICP, brand voice) and plan (marketing.plan). 2. Identify 3-5 content pillars from customer segments and value propositions. 3. Propose formats + cadence per channel. 4. Draft 2 example pieces (headline + outline + CTA).
## HITL Always deliver as workspace.activity.suggestion. Never publish directly.
SEO audits, programmatic content, keyword strategy and on-page optimization grounded in web data.

# Marketing SEO
Optimize web presence with SEO audits and programmatic content.
## Process 1. Gather current pages/URLs and target segments. 2. Build keyword clusters mapped to customer segments. 3. Propose on-page changes and content gaps. 4. Prioritize by impact/effort.
## HITL Deliver as suggestions; implement only after approval.
Paid acquisition: ad campaigns, creatives, budgets, and channel mix optimization.
ads, annonser, kampanj, acquisition, spend, budget

# Marketing Acquisition (Paid)
Optimize ad campaigns and creative performance.
## Process 1. Read campaign context (channels, budget, target segments). 2. Suggest channel mix and budget allocation. 3. Draft ad creatives per channel (headline, body, CTA). 4. Define tracking/measurement plan.
## HITL Budgets and campaigns require explicit approval before change.
Analyze marketing performance, funnels, competitor activity, and attribution from Odoo data.
analytics, analys, funnel, konvertering, attribution, rapport

# Marketing Analytics
Analyze marketing performance and competitor activity.
## Process 1. Collect metrics from CRM, campaigns, and analytics sources. 2. Build funnel view and identify drop-off points. 3. Compare against targets and benchmarks. 4. Recommend experiments with expected impact.
## HITL Insights are read-only; experiments go through approval queue.
Comprehensive AARRR marketing plans from business data — acquisition, activation, retention, revenue, referral.
plan, strategi, aarrr, roadmap, marketing plan, marknadsplan

# Marketing Plan (AARRR)
Create comprehensive marketing plans from business data.
## Process 1. Read customer, BMC (value propositions, segments), and context. 2. Build AARRR funnel with concrete actions per stage. 3. Assign owner, channel, budget estimate, and success metric per action. 4. Produce the plan as structured output.
## HITL The plan itself is a deliverable; execution actions require approval.
Social media planning: post ideas from OKF concepts, scheduling, and channel-specific copy.
social, linkedin, instagram, post, inlägg, publicering

# Marketing Social
Transform OKF concepts into scheduled social posts.
## Process 1. Read 3+ relevant ai.okf.concept records. 2. Draft post ideas per channel (LinkedIn, Instagram, X). 3. Each idea becomes workspace.activity.suggestion with evidence_ids. 4. After approval, create social_marketing.post in draft (never publish directly).
## HITL always — suggestions only, no auto-publication.
Conversion rate optimization: landing pages, A/B tests, funnel improvements, churn prevention.
konvertering, conversion, cro, ab-test, churn, onboarding

# Marketing Conversion
Improve conversion and retention.
## Process 1. Identify conversion bottlenecks in the funnel. 2. Propose A/B test hypotheses with expected impact. 3. Include churn prevention actions for at-risk accounts. 4. Define success metrics and measurement.
## HITL Tests require approval before rollout.
Referral and partner programs: co-marketing, community, advocacy, and incentive design.
referral, partner, co-marketing, community, advocacy, ambassadör

# Marketing Referral
Design referral and partner programs.
## Process 1. Read customer base segments and partner landscape. 2. Design incentive structure (reward, threshold, channel). 3. Propose co-marketing and community actions. 4. Define program KPIs and rollout plan.
## HITL Incentives and partner commitments require approval.
